title: Good Tidings | Pet Friendly 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Private beach access just 350 feet away at this Sunrise Beach retreat with private pool, LSV, beach service, bikes, pet friendly, near Gulf Place dining.
description_expanded: Special Promo! Enter code GOODTIDINGS10 at check out to receive 10% off for arrivals April 10 - May 14, 2026* Good Tidings Private Beach Access plus Private Pool and LSV in Sunrise Beach Home Introduction Relax just 350 feet from a private, gated beach in Good Tidings , a 4BR/3BA retreat in the intimate Sunrise Beach community south of 30A. With a private pool, included 6-seater LSV, beach service, and pet-friendly options , this home is the ideal coastal getaway for families seeking comfort, convenience, and proximity to Gulf Place. Home Highlights - Beach Proximity - Only 350 feet to the private Sunrise Beach access - Private Pool - Fenced-in, with loungers, outdoor dining, and propane grill (heated Oct-Apr for fee) - 6-Seater LSV Golf Cart - Included with stay; waiver required - 4 Taxi Bikes - Regularly serviced for smooth rides - Beach Service Included - 4 chairs + 2 umbrellas (March-October) - Pet Friendly - Pre-approval and a fee for up to 2 dogs (60 lbs or less, non-aggressive) - Prime Location - 1-minute bike or 4-minute stroll to Gulf Place dining and shops - Driveway Parking - Space for 3 vehicles (no RVs, trailers, or street parking) - Open-Concept 1st Floor - Living room with Smart TV, dining for 6, breakfast bar for 4 - Fully Equipped Kitchen - Stainless appliances plus Keurig and drip coffee maker - Multiple Balconies - Covered front porch, plus front- and pool-facing balconies - SmartTVs Throughout - Basic cable + streaming capability - Laundry Room - Washer and dryer - Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay - Flexible for Families - 2 king suites + large queen room + bunk room Location Perks - 4 minutes stroll to Gulf Place restaurants, boutiques and live events - Minutes to Oyster Lake and Draper Lake - rare coastal dune lakes unique to 30A - Quick access to Shunk Gulley, rated top 10% worldwide on TripAdvisor - Central to shopping - Publix, YOLO rentals, bike shops, coffee, artisans Know Before You Go - Mid-stay clean required for stays 10+ days (included in reservation cost) - Unauthorized pets result in fines + possible eviction - Neighborhood parking restrictions - No RVs, trailers, or street parking - Concierge available for grocery delivery, kayak and YOLO board rentals, eBikes, beach bonfires, and more *Discount is applied to the rental rate only. Promos or discounts cannot be combined. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | Smart TV, ensuite access to full bath with walk-in shower. Hallway access also available to the full bath
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | Smart TV, private balcony with seating and view of pool area, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Guest Room | Sleeps up to 4 in two Queen beds, TV, private balcony overlooking from of home, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 2 in a Twin over Twin Bunk, TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
